facts.text: Helium Vector Magnetometer (HVM) was deployed at Interstellar Trajectory — Aldebaran & Aquila during Pioneer 10 & 11 in 1972.
6.6-meter lightweight folding fiberglass mast isolating a sensitive helium gas cell magnetometer from spacecraft electrical interference.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the deep-space environment.
Discovered the enormous, intense Jovian magnetosphere and its devastating radiation belts.
Status: Silent and dormant in deep space.
Established the fundamental magnetic architecture of gas giants in our Solar System.
